title: Selector
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox HDL Support/Signal Management/Selector.md
text: Select input elements from vector, matrix, or multidimensional signal, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Interval between samples; {Number of input dimensions} sets the number of dimensions of input signal, {Index mode}, {Index Option} sets the index method for elements, {Index}, {Output Size} sets the width of block output signal, {Input port size} sets the width of input signal and {Check for out-of-range index in accelerated simulation} sets the option to check for out-of-range index values in accelerator and rapid accelerator simulation. Values come from the instance.
